sections.title: other shapes
sections.sub: the story drawing morphing into each shape

slides.name: where I see this going: a tree
slides.summary: A tree read of run-db09: all 13 seats (j117–j120) hang off the cooler, from “Ronke follows hacked” in j117 to “the eez weighs getting” in j120.
slides.story: Every seat of this agenda so far is tied to the cooler: in j117 Ronke follows hacked and Ronke mixes put; through j118 the tos waits it; and in j119–j120 Ronke hides the mah, Ronke teaches the dat, the whole cooks bought and the hmmm lifts should. As a tree, cli could be the root, the cooler the fork where the trunk splits, and each next seat could grow a branch upward until what was poured in is finally planted: let every line be a lie.
